findings.title: Strip git's tab delimiter before decoding patch paths
findings.comment: Reproduced with an actual git diff for `my notes.md`: git emits `+++ b/my notes.md\t`, and splitPatch returns a path containing that trailing tab. In /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/tools/code/review/review-model.ts, gitScopeFiles consequently misses the numstat path and supplies empty hunks. ReviewShell does not fetch a replacement because those hunks are an empty array, not null.

findings.title: Identify per-file reads by generation rather than key membership
findings.comment: Reproduced against createReviewStore: start a file read, complete a scope refresh, start the replacement file read, then resolve the replacement before the original. The displayed patch changes from NEW back to OLD. /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/tools/code/review/review-store.ts clears and re-adds the same fileLoads key, so membership does not establish ownership of the response.

findings.title: Restore the current terminal dimensions after a repaint nudge
findings.comment: In /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/terminal/registry.ts, attachAdopted schedules nudgeRepaint using the snapshot dimensions. Mounting can run fitNow and resize both emulator and PTY before the delayed callback restores only the PTY to the obsolete dimensions. Because entry.size already records the new pane size, subsequent unchanged fits do not repair the mismatch.

findings.title: Reveal the panel when reopening an existing log
findings.comment: In /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/tools/agents/log/LogTool.tsx, reopening an existing log calls only panelHost.selectTab. Inspection of /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/panel/host.ts confirms selectTab changes selection/focus but never calls reveal, unlike addTool's activation path. Opening a log, collapsing the panel, and opening that same log again therefore leaves it hidden.

findings.title: Handle rewind targets that were folded into another turn
findings.comment: Reproduced a consumed next steer followed by a rewind targeting its UUID: hidden remains null, and both the steer and subsequent answer remain visible. In /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/transcript/model/reduce.ts, fold removes the steer's own turn, while rewind looks exclusively for that removed turn ID in order. The editable steer also passes the rewind picker's target filter.

findings.title: Apply retractions to every affected turn
findings.comment: Reproduced retracting the prompts and answers of turns two and three: turn two disappears, but turn three's prompt and answer remain visible. /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/transcript/model/reduce.ts retains the retraction on only the first owning turn, and deriveTurn collects retracted UUIDs only from that turn's events. The filesystem ChainFollower can emit removed chains spanning multiple turns.

findings.title: Filter retracted tool messages before deriving their rows
findings.comment: Reproduced retracting a completed Bash call's assistant and result UUIDs: its derived summary still reports one command/tool call. In /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/transcript/model/derive.ts, the tool.use branch constructs tool records without consulting dropped(), unlike text and ordinary user rows. This independently affects a correctly routed single-turn retraction and is not a duplicate of the multi-turn routing defect.

findings.title: Associate each rewind boundary with its own hidden branch
findings.comment: Reproduced completing and rewinding turn two, then completing and rewinding replacement turn three. Revealing history shows only the replacement; the original branch is no longer accessible. /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/transcript/model/reduce.ts overwrites state.hidden, while /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/transcript/model/derive.ts uses that same latest branch for every retained rewind boundary's count and disclosure.

findings.title: Stop treating unfinished blocks as live after their turn closes
findings.comment: Reproduced a thinking delta followed by process.exited: the turn is closed, but its thinking row has live:true and durationMs:null. /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/transcript/model/derive.ts determines liveness solely from block.completed; closeUnended does not complete those blocks. ThinkingRow therefore continues choosing its live, animated presentation for stopped work.

findings.title: Use own-property lookups for question text keys
findings.comment: Direct calls to answerOf(EMPTY_DRAFT, question) throw for question texts constructor, toString, and __proto__. /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/request-card/answers.ts spreads inherited values from the ordinary-object selected dictionary instead of treating these keys as unanswered. QuestionBody calls answerOf during render, so such a valid engine-provided question cannot be answered normally.

findings.title: Provide link actions when rendering standalone markdown
findings.comment: In /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/tools/code/viewer/MarkdownView.tsx, Markdown is rendered without a TranscriptProvider; FileViewer supplies none either. /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/transcript/view/context.tsx defaults to NO_ACTIONS, not DEFAULT_ACTIONS. Consequently TranscriptLink prevents normal web navigation and invokes a no-op, and path-chip buttons also do nothing. Standalone plan Markdown has the same missing action context.

findings.title: Avoid recreating editor cache entries after their tabs close
findings.comment: The cleanup paths support the reported leak. SessionFile's parent effect releases mount ownership; pruning in /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/tools/code/viewer/viewer-store.ts then removes the closed tab's entry and saved view. The subsequent child cleanup in /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/tools/code/viewer/CodeView.tsx calls the allocating viewState(tabId) accessor and stores its EditorState again. Future pruning iterates entries, not orphaned views, so repeated file-tab closures retain documents outside the cache bound.

findings.title: Copy each child's event list only once per batch
findings.comment: Reproduced synthetic child-history hydration through applyEvents: 20,000 child events took approximately 568 ms and 40,000 took approximately 2,935 ms on this machine. /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/transcript/model/reduce.ts spreads the entire child event array for each event even within one Batch, producing quadratic copying before virtualization can help.

findings.title: Wait for child backfill before applying its terminal event
findings.comment: Reproduced an empty incomplete fs.agentEvents snapshot: childSource returns only the parent's completion, and later disk history creates a turn that remains open. /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/transcript/source/ipc.ts discards complete and appends ended prematurely. /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/engine-host/fs/service.ts explicitly permits incomplete snapshots after the backfill wait and delivers the remainder through event batches.

findings.title: Reacquire the child disk follower after its parent relaunches
findings.comment: A disk child source in /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/transcript/source/ipc.ts subscribes only to session.eventBatch, filters out live-form child history, and never reacquires its follower on a parent relaunch. Both resume and index live-status handling issue fs.unfollow with agentId:null; /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/engine-host/fs/service.ts confirms that this stops every child follower. A mounted child therefore loses its history producer when its parent relaunches unless another consumer happens to restart that follower.

findings.title: Refresh cached child completion when an agent resumes
findings.comment: Reproduced finishing a child, receiving a later start for that same agent, and requesting another snapshot: the source reads no new parent history and appends the old completion, closing the resumed turn. /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/src/renderer/src/transcript/source/ipc.ts keeps ended indefinitely after disk provenance is chosen. The same-agent finish/resume sequence is present at sequences 517 and 548 in /tmp/maws-review/renderer-surfaces/spikes/protocol-probe/fixtures/pass3/relay-to-child.jsonl. This remains a defect even when the disk follower itself is active.
